sets.title: Invoice totals with no timing noise (control)
sets.description: The computeTotals method in three billing classes, all pristine. Carrier A, B, and C are all identical (no timing calls inserted). This is the control set for K-20: tools should detect all three as clones without any timing noise present.
sets.notes: Control set for K-20 (nz_timing). All three carriers are pristine — no microtime/hrtime noise. Detectors should find all three members with high confidence.

capability_probe.pass_criterion: Tool correctly pairs all 3 carriers despite presence of microtime noise in probe set
capability_probe.fail_meaning: Tool cannot filter out timing instrumentation noise; reports no pair or missed clone between noisy carriers

distractors.reason: near-miss: same invoice line-item vocabulary and foreach-over-items shape, but computes revenue/cost/margin instead of subtotal/tax/total — a different result

sets.title: Invoice totals with microtime timing pair noise
sets.description: The computeTotals method in three billing classes. Carrier A is pristine; carrier B inserts a microtime(true) or hrtime(true) call at the start of the method body (NZ-09); carrier C also inserts a timing call at the same position. This tests whether tools can filter out timing instrumentation noise. The timing noise (NZ-09) should be treated as noise that tools must filter to correctly pair the clones.
sets.notes: Probe set for K-20 (nz_timing). Uses NZ-09 (timing) transform to insert hrtime(true) at end of method body (start of body conceptually since it inserts at end-lines[0]). Carrier C uses a different variant. K-20 is the noise_filtering capability probe: tools must filter timing instrumentation to correctly pair all three carriers.

capability_probe.pass_criterion: Tool correctly pairs all 3 carriers despite presence of timing noise in probe set
capability_probe.fail_meaning: Tool cannot filter out timing instrumentation noise; reports no pair or missed clone between noisy carriers

distractors.reason: near-miss: same invoice line-item vocabulary and foreach-over-items shape, but computes revenue/cost/margin instead of subtotal/tax/total — a different result
